channel.title: Need help with changing text in a similar way to offsets
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Need help with changing text in a similar way to offsets" - Need a way of changing a lot of text with a single button

item.title: Re: Need help with changing text in a similar way to offsets
item.content:encoded:
The definitive guide on ListPages stuff is ListPages Magic and You, which walks you through and explains how multi-iteration stuff works. In essence you make a couple hidden pages, then a main page with the ListPages, which pulls content from those hidden pages.

That guide semi-strongly advises using the order="created_at" parameter, but if you'd like it to be random you can change it to order="random". In order to get your reader to reload the page, you can provide a button somewhere that contains a link to the page itself; e.g. if you page is SCP-4260 then use [[[SCP-4260 | Refresh page?]]].

This will effectively mean that the contents of your reader sees will be random and cycle through randomly upon refreshing the page. If you have any further questions feel free to reach out.

item.title: Re: Need help with changing text in a similar way to offsets
item.content:encoded:
There’s a way to do this but it would require an understanding of HTML/CSS/Javascript and to put the majority of your SCP in an HTML block.

Just seems easier to have a bunch of iterations with the ListPages thing and have your button be a disguised link to the next offset.

If the text changes are meant to be random, i.e. inconsistent across reading experiences, then that can also be done and I can walk you through it.

item.title: Need help with changing text in a similar way to offsets
item.content:encoded:
I'm currently experimenting in the sandbox with a high hume level SCP which primarily affects a person's cognitive function, I'm planning on having a way to click a button which then adds and removes text from the document, sort of like seeing the article through a filter which changes the way you see the information.
Example: SCP-XXXX Object Class: Safe Description: SCP-XXXX is a bird.
— push button, activating the effect —
SCP-XXXX Object Class: Keter Description: SCP-XXXX is a massive metal eating moth.
Would it be through offsets/sister pages or is there a guide for code like this?
